# cloptima_llm_virtual_key (Data Source)

Reads an existing Cloptima LLM virtual key by ID or by name. A name lookup searches active virtual keys only and fails if more than one matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a virtual key by name
data "cloptima_llm_virtual_key" "copilot" {
  name = "customer-copilot-prod-key"
}

output "virtual_key_status" {
  value = data.cloptima_llm_virtual_key.copilot.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Virtual key ID. Specify either id or name.
- `name` (String) Virtual key name. Specify either id or name.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) Bound application ID.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `default_credential_id` (String) Default provider credential ID.
- `default_credential_ids` (String) Per-provider default credential IDs JSON map.
- `environment` (String) Bound environment.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp.
- `membership_id` (String) Membership ID this virtual key is issued under.
- `status` (String) Virtual key status: active, revoked, or expired.
- `team_id` (String) Bound team ID.
- `token_prefix` (String) Non-secret prefix of the virtual key.
